name: figma_screenshot
description: Capture a visual PNG screenshot of specific nodes or the current selection in Figma. Highly recommended after UI modifications to inspect layout alignment, contrast, typography, and spacing.

node_ids.description: Optional comma-separated list of Figma node IDs to screenshot (e.g. '123:456, 123:457'). If omitted, captures current selection or entire page.

description.description: Optional action description for Figma toast and logs.

target.description: fileName of a specific connected Figma document, when more than one is open (see figma_list_targets).
